check_file_copyright: check if a file has the Meta copyright header and optionally autofix it
check_file_autofix: autofix a missing copyright header in a Python or TypeScript file
test_all_files_copyright: test all git tracked files in the repo for copyright headers
run_autofix_headers: run the script to autofix copyright headers on all source files in the repo
check_file_typescript: check and autofix copyright headers in TypeScript, JavaScript, or CSS files
